How is the gestational age calculated?

"The gestational age (how many weeks pregnant you are) is calculated from the first day of your last menstrual period (LMP).
The exact date of conception is often impossible to define, but it usually happens about 2 weeks later — during the fertile window.
To avoid confusion, doctors use the LMP method for pregnancy dating. Flo does the same! It shows insights based on the gestational age."
